claim.statement: The substrate's emission distribution under BGE-M3 has ≥250 unique canonicals AND ≥150 English-words AND ≥4 of 5 internal-event kinds firing on a 60-cycle default-prompt run.
claim.operationalization: 60-cycle Kimera run on 12 default prompts; capture all Arachne emit events to JSONL; categorize each unique canonical by source signature regex (english_word_natural, internal_event:<kind>, alexandria_fused, etc.).
claim.h0: At least one of (unique≥250, english≥150, internal_kinds≥4) fails

preregistration.analysis_plan: Pre-registered per ROADMAP_2026_05_18.md Phase 1c. 60-cycle Kimera default-prompt run with emit JSONL capture. Three independent thresholds checked: n_unique≥250, english_words≥150, internal_kinds≥4. VALIDATED if all 3 met; PARTIAL if some; REFUTED if internal_kinds≤2.

detail.interpretation: English-word count under BGE is 60% of FastText era (130 vs 216). Diagnosis: Phase 219.2 semantic expansion (FastText-vocab iteration) is dormant under BGE-M3 because BGE has no precomputed vocab table. Roadmap Phase 4 will introduce BGE-native expansion to restore this.

4 of 5 internal-event kinds fire (cronos_drift dormant by design per EV-37 — rare-event detector). Quantum amplitude bursts fire 12× more under BGE than under FastText (60 vs 5) — consistent with BGE's higher phi values (Phase 1b finding).

verdict.reasoning: Conditions met: 2/3. unique=283, english=130, internal=4/5. Verdict tier: PARTIAL. English shortfall traced to dormant Phase 219.2 expansion (FastText-removal consequence); roadmap Phase 4 fixes.
